title: Chapter 351
text:
After staying on Planet Sunil for about a month, Han Xiao and the others finally returned to Juberly Hub. As soon as they returned, the first thing Han Xiao did was to change the medium-sized lounge into a large stronghold. The rent increased from 40 Enas to 100 Enas, and the space was larger and not cramped.

The more majestic a faction's stronghold was, the more reliable the members would feel. In fact, Han Xiao felt that spaceships were the best mobile strongholds, but a spaceship was too expensive. The players would not be able to afford it even if they cut off all their kidneys. However, human bodies were not popular in the galactic organ market either.

If they had money, they would squander it. A Mechanic's view of spending had always been to make money back after spending it.

This trip was quite rewarding. The players had earned tens of thousands, and Han Xiao had to do a round of harvesting before he could earn enough to buy the two class advancement knowledges.

Professional players would definitely use their spare money to buy equipment, and Juberly Hub had many private equipment stores open to different races. These were all competitors.

I can't make the players only spend money here. The players have their own preferences, and I can't deprive them of their freedom. Otherwise, it will be detrimental to the development of the faction. No one likes to be forced. Furthermore, the things I sell may not be able to satisfy all their needs … However, I only need a portion of the players' wealth. Many a little makes a mickle, and the profit is already huge enough.

Although Han Xiao had many ways to earn money, he had always kept his desire to earn money within a rational range.

He updated the faction exchange list and added the Defense Type, Assault Type, and Reconnaissance Type Sunil Soldier Armor. The first requirement was 500 Faction Favorability points and 800 Enas before they could be exchanged.

In the new stronghold, before the players could move freely, someone discovered the new items in the faction store.

Mad Blade was surprised. "This is the Soldier Armor we saw on Sunil?"

Hao Tian was confused. "That's right. This is their technology. How can a mercenary group exchange for other organizations' equipment?"

The players were instantly curious.

Pork Bun suddenly had an idea and gave a reasonable idea. "A mercenary group should be a faction with growth potential. By accepting different missions, they can update the faction store. The more missions they accept, the stronger the faction will be …"

Everyone thought about the addition of Herlous and the growth shown on the faction interface when they first joined Black Star. They all felt that it made sense, and excitement gushed out of them.

It turned out that the actions of the players could allow the faction to grow!

"We might have joined a special faction!" Mad Blade was excited.

All of them were professional players. They immediately thought of the advantages of being a mercenary group. If they were hired by a different faction, the exchange list would be updated with equipment from that faction. Then, as long as they completed more quests, the mercenary group would have more options for exchange. This way, they would not have to join other factions for equipment. They would only need to increase the Favorability of the mercenary group.

They were the first batch of players to enter the galaxy. Back then, they had even undergone a difficult selection. Could it be that joining this faction was a hidden benefit?

The players believed that this characteristic of the mercenary group came from Han Xiao. The main character of the storyline had to be special. The players trusted Han Xiao very much, as if anything could happen. This was the image that Han Xiao had been trying to create for the players.

Letting the players feel that the growth of the faction was' driven 'by them and clearly seeing the growth of the faction would allow them to slowly form a sense of belonging. This was also the development path that he had set in the beginning. Now that the players finally felt this characteristic, they felt a sense of novelty. His strategy had achieved the desired effect.

At this time, the players had money in their pockets. A few of them immediately bought the soldier armor. Han Xiao did not have the real thing, so he had to order one. The other players were more pragmatic and planned to observe the real thing after it was done.

When Sunil was fighting, every player had their eyes on the soldier armor. Unfortunately, they did not have the means to buy it. Second Prince had even almost wanted to steal one.

"We've been fighting for more than a month. Let's all rest for a while."

Han Xiao dismissed everyone, left the stronghold, and rented a machinery modification room.

He first spent a few million EXP to raise the level of the armor blueprint to Level 6 before starting to build it. He still had a lot of materials left from the Blue Star. Only a small portion of the Sunil soldier armor needed to be bought from the galaxy, and the cost of one set was only about 50 Enas.

The mercenary group did not have any missions for the time being, so the players could finally walk around Juberly Hub. Of course, they would not only spend their money in one place.

There were many shops in the hub, and there was a wide variety of products to choose from. During this period of rest, everyone saw the equipment of different civilizations and bought quite a lot of equipment, such as more powerful guns and small support machines.

At the same time, they discovered that some machinery shops were also selling soldier armor. This was very common in the galaxy. Although the appearance of these armors was very different from Sunil's, the technology behind them was more basic. However, the prices in the shops were much more expensive than the ones in the mercenary group. The cheapest one cost 3,200 Enas, which was three times more expensive!

However, the players started to worry. You get what you pay for. Han Xiao's armor was so cheap, so would its attributes be bad?

Everyone secretly memorized the attributes of the armor in the shops and planned to compare them when the products of the mercenary group were out.

Although Black Star's equipment was more expensive, when professional players had money, they would only look at the quality and not the price.

…

Herlous went to the mercenary hall alone to register and join the Black Star Mercenary. He opened the mercenary group resume.

—

Black Star Mercenary

Credibility Points: 154

Group Size: 53

Level: 52

Grade B: 1

Missions Completed: 1 (Low-level daily missions are not included)

Active Area: Garton Star System

Resume: [Sunil Defender Battle (Collapse/Expand)]

Founder: Black Star – Han Xiao

Creation Date: Year 688, October 2

Summary: A small mercenary group with a certain level of combat ability. There is one Grade B Super member.

—

"A mercenary group that has only been established for a month? Black Star didn't lie to me …" Herlous saw that there was only one Grade B in the group and knew that he was the strongest in the group. He could not help but feel a sense of responsibility.

For the future of the race, he had to protect Han Xiao. He hoped that this captain would not choose missions that were too dangerous.

On the other side, Han Xiao, who was making armor in the workshop, received a notification from the interface.

Faction Reward Limit: 135700

Leader Level v80: + 64000

Officer: Herlous (B) + 20000

-53 Group Size: + 20000

-7 Renown: + 14000

Legendary Point: Leader (3) + 15%

Allies or Enemies: None

Sunil's Friendliness was in the category of individuals and had not risen to the level of faction allies.

Han Xiao was energized. The faction had obtained its first officer and taken the first step. The reward limit had increased by 20,000. Recruiting officers was indeed a good way to increase the reward limit quickly.

Two days later, Han Xiao made six sets of soldier armor. The players could not wait to try them on and instantly felt the convenience.

Individual armor was a topic that most civilizations would definitely research when they reached a certain level. The original intention was to allow individuals to obtain a stronger physique and adapt to different environments. When the players put on the individual armor for the first time, it was like opening the door to a new world.

In the stronghold, a few players who had bought the armor excitedly operated the armor. The new control feeling made them very happy, and the other players surrounded them and touched them curiously.

"How does it feel?"

"It looks heavy, but it's actually very convenient to move around. There's a power structure inside."

Rainy Kim frowned and coldly said, "A bunch of metal lumps. They look so ugly."

All the male players glared at her and for the first time, they had a common enemy.

"What do you know? Mechanical armor is a man's romance!"
